newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed prices slide on low volumes.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed prices slide on low volumes.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices eased by 2/3 rupees to 1,155/1,156 rupees per quintal on scattered speculative offerings on Thursday, dealers said.
"Volumes were dull and movement narrow but sentiment was weak on sluggish enquiries from exporters as well as weak trends in the world market," one dealer said.
Castorseed June delivery was quoted higher by 10/15 rupees to 1,225/1,230 rupees per quintal but trading was nominal.

"For the March and June delivery now there will be no daily clearing and the system of daily clearing will be implemented for September delivery which is yet to open," said Navin Shah, president of the Bombay Oil Exchange.
Groundnut oil was steady at 338/340 rupees per 10 kg and imported palm oil at 281/282 rupees per 10 kg. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 510/515 rupees per 15 kg.
